arguments.summary: An emergency access request from IP 10.0.5.14 was flagged, but investigation revealed the actual threat originated from host WS-FIN-042 (10.0.5.42), belonging to user jsmith@corp.local in Finance. The host exhibited Cobalt Strike beaconing behavior to an external C2 server (198.51.100.23) at 2026-04-09T02:17:33Z. Follow-on activities included suspicious rundll32 execution, failed Kerberos authentication attempts, and lateral movement via SMB to a file server. Despite detection, containment actions (firewall block, EPP isolation) were denied due to procedural or targeting errors. The destination IP 10.0.8.200 showed prior scanning activity but was not the origin of compromise.

title: Suspicious rundll32 Execution from Temp Directory
logsource:

  product: windows
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith: '\\rundll32.exe'
    CommandLine|contains:
      - '%TEMP%'
      - '/c'
      - 'http'
  condition: selection
level: high
